patterns.title: 太…了 / 不太…
patterns.explanation: 太 + adjective + 了 expresses a strong reaction here. 不太 + adjective softens a negative assessment; the source examples do not add this final 了.
patterns.pitfall: 不太远 is not the same as 很近; it softens the negative without giving a precise distance.
patterns.application: Give an enthusiastic personal reaction, then a measured service description.

patterns.title: 到 / 马上 / 等一下
patterns.explanation: 到 reports reaching a place; 马上 places an event in the near future in these examples. Wait expressions manage the interaction rather than promise a precise number of minutes.
patterns.pitfall: 我马上到 does not mean I am already there. Do not invent a precise wait time.
patterns.application: Send an arrival update and one polite waiting request.

patterns.title: 到 + place + 了
patterns.explanation: This source pattern reports arrival or a newly reached situation. Contrast 去酒店 (go to the hotel) and 在酒店 (be at the hotel). 了 is not a general past-tense marker.
patterns.pitfall: In this target pattern put 了 after the place. 到了酒店 is possible in other constructions and is not universally wrong.
patterns.application: Report that you have arrived, then state where the guest is now. Explain the change in meaning.

patterns.title: 一共: specify the unit of a total
patterns.explanation: 一共 introduces a total across stated rooms, people or items. Slide 9 gives a combined total for two rooms, without specifying nights or a nightly rate.
patterns.pitfall: Do not infer equal prices or included charges from a combined total.
patterns.application: Clarify the total with 不是…，是…. Ask about one detail not supplied.

patterns.title: 可以…吗？ / 请…
patterns.explanation: 可以…吗？ asks whether an action is permitted here. 请 makes a request or invitation more courteous. Respecting a refusal is a supplementary pragmatic extension of the source.
examples: 服务员：您好!我是服务员，可以进来吗？
patterns.pitfall: A polite request is not itself consent. Wait for an answer and acknowledge 现在不方便.
patterns.application: Make a luggage-delivery request and respond naturally when the guest declines.

patterns.title: 请不要 + verb phrase
patterns.explanation: 不要 expresses a prohibition or discouragement in the source examples. 请 can make delivery more courteous, but the scope of the instruction still matters.
patterns.pitfall: The source’s shoe instruction concerns entering 佛殿, not every space on every temple site. Confirm the site-specific instruction.
patterns.application: Give a clear instruction and a respectful next step without inventing a rule.

patterns.title: 以前 / 现在 / 以后；但是
patterns.explanation: Time expressions distinguish before, now and later. 但是 introduces a contrast or limitation; in the source permission exchange it adds a condition to 可以.
examples: 我以前是老师，现在是导游。
可以，但是请不要穿鞋进佛殿。
patterns.pitfall: A visitor’s earlier experience does not establish the present site’s rules.
patterns.application: Compare a previous impression with a present enquiry.

patterns.title: 以前…过吗？ / 发现…
patterns.explanation: 以前…过吗？ asks about prior experience; 发现 introduces something noticed. A personal observation does not establish an exhaustive cultural fact.
examples: 我发现泰国有很多寺庙。
patterns.pitfall: A description of Buddhism in the source does not define every individual’s beliefs.
patterns.application: Ask about previous experience, then invite a specific question.
